dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (This old diary seems to have seen a lot of use. It's full of traces of wear-and-tear.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...A miner came here, and he looked awful. We let him stay here for a few days and he recovered decently..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...It seems that his wife and his son are still on the island, but he rejected our offer to help him find them. Instead, he thanked us and just left. What a strange man..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Brother Takano has a high fever that won't abate. Many of us have been awakened by nightmares in the middle of the night. Everyone's on tenterhooks, and we're not feeling too great. Is it a seasonal thing?"
